title: Ted: The Animated Series Reveals Big Returns With New Sneak Peek – Watch Now
content:
Ted is coming back with a brand new animated series hitting Peacock later this December, and a new sneak peek clip from Ted: The Animated Series is highlighting some big returns from the massively popular TV series. Ted has found new life through the success of its Peacock TV series , and now Seth MacFarlane’s universe is set to expand with a new animated series keeping the franchise going. But it’s taking things in a new direction that blends both the TV and movie releases.

Ted: The Animated Series picks up 12 years after the events of Ted 2 , and focuses on the older versions of John and Ted as the two of them now have wacky family adventures together. But thankfully it’s brought two of the fan favorites from the TV series into the fold with a new sneak peek clip showing off Susan (Alanna Ubach) and Matty (Scott Grimes). You can check it out in action below.

When Does Ted: The Animated Series Come Out?

Ted: The Animated Series will be making its debut with Peacock on Thursday, December 17th with eight episodes all available at once. Additional episodes of the animated series planned for a release sometime in 2027, but no concrete release date has been announced as of this time. The series is set 12 years after the events of the Ted films, and brings back its core cast with Seth MacFarlane as Ted, Mark Wahlberg as John, Amanda Seyfried as Sam, and Jessica Barth as Tami-Lynn. Kyle Mooney and Liz Richman join the cast as Apollo and Ruth, new additions to their families.

Ted: The Animated Series thankfully incorporates two of the big fan favorite changes to the Ted universe seen with the Ted TV series. Alanna Ubach and Scott Grimes’ versions of John’s parents are completely different than seen in the film franchise, and luckily they will be making their return to the franchise with this animated series despite it taking place within the universe of the films. But there’s still a glaring absence from Giorgia Whigham’s Blaire through the promotional materials so far.

What Does This Mean for Ted Season 3?

For those fans of the Ted TV series, the humor of this new animated version seems to be more in line with it. That’s also helped by the fact that Ted: The Animated Series is created Seth MacFarlane, Paul Corrigan and Brad Walsh, who were also showrunners of the live-action series. It seems that while a third season of the live-action series might not be in the cards for the moment as it’s been deemed too “expensive” for Peacock , the team has found a creative way to keep things going.

Ted: The Animated Series might not be the kind of continuation that fans of the Peacock series might have been hoping to see , but with Matty and Susan returning for the new adventures to blend with the movie’s cast that’s going to make it all the more appealing to see how the team is able to work together both worlds. But how are you feeling about Ted: The Animated Series so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: At 25:00, in Akasaka Gets Anime
content:
At 25:00, in Akasaka boys’ love manga by Hiroko Natsuno is getting an anime adaptation. A teaser visual and trailer have also been unveiled and the main cast will reprise their roles from the drama CDs, with Soma Saito voicing Yuki Shirasaki and Takuya Sato voicing Asami Hayama. The anime premieres in 2027.

Comments from the cast have also been released:

Yuki Shirasaki – Voice Actor: Soma Saito First and foremost, congratulations on the anime adaptation!My name is Soma Saito, and I will be voicing Yuki Shirasaki.I first encountered the original manga when I was cast in the dramaCD. I vividly remember being captivated first by the beauty of thecharacters’ eyes, and then by the story and its characters. I becamecompletely engrossed in reading it. I’m truly delighted to have theopportunity to be involved once again as a cast member in a work thatmeans so much to me. I’ll give it my all.I look forward to working on this project!

Asami Hayama – Voice Actor: Takuya Sato Congratulations on the anime adaptation of “At 25:00, in Akasaka”I’m delighted to be returning as the voice of Asami Hayama, continuingfrom the drama CDs.Rather than simply reminiscing about the time I’ve spent bringing thesecharacters to life alongside Soma Saito, who voices Yuki Shirasaki, I’mlooking forward to meeting Shirasaki’s eyes again with a fresh andgenuine sense of excitement when we begin recording.I’m excited to see how Hiroko Natsuno-sensei’s delicate and intricateworld will be brought to life through animation. I hope you’ll lookforward to it!

Currently serialized in Shodensha’s onBLUE, the original manga has achieved over 2 million copies in circulation, including digital editions. The series also won two awards at the BL Award 2023, taking home both Best Series and Best BL CD. Aside from manga, the title has expanded into drama CDs, merchandise, and collaboration cafés. In 2024, a live action-drama series adaptation aired.

Synopsis: Yuki Shirasaki (26), a newcomer actor, is set to star in a romantic drama about a relationship between twomen alongside Asami Hayama (28), a hugely popular actor who was also his upperclassman at university.Struggling to convincingly portray a gay character, Shirasaki visits a gay bar in search of someone who canhelp him understand the role. However, for some reason, he ends up getting caught up with Hayama, andthe two enter into a relationship as lovers… all for the sake of their acting. Their secret relationship, all for the sake of their roles, begins as filming gets underway! Source: Press Release ©︎Hiroko Natsuno, SHODENSHA/ ”At25:00inAkasaka” Production Committee

title: 'Kakunaru Ue wa' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content:
The official website of the Kakunaru Ue wa ( Now That We Draw ) television anime unveiled additional cast, a key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and second promotional video on Wednesday. The anime series adapting Kyuu Takahata and Yuuji Kaba 's romantic comedy manga is scheduled to premiere on January 9 at 12:30 a.m. on Tokyo MX and BS11, followed by AT-X.

Voice actors Hina Youmiya ( Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu ) and Kousuke Toriumi ( Youjo Senki ) are joining the cast as Ren Shioiri and Oyamada, respectively.

Singer-songwriter shallm ( Watari-kun no xx ga Houkai Sunzen ) is performing the opening theme "Kimi-iro Hirari." Rock band Inner Journey ( Sekai Saikyou no Kouei ) is performing the ending theme "Serifu wa Iranai." The opening theme is previewed in the second promotional video below.

Shunsuke Ishikawa ( Blue Lock: Episode Nagi ) is directing the anime at ROLL2 , with Deko Akao ( Witch Watch ) handling the series composition and script. Hiromi Nakagawa ( Shiro Seijo to Kuro Bokushi ) is designing the characters. Yoshiaki Miura is composing the music.

Takahata and Kaba began serializing the romantic comedy manga in Young Animal in February 2023. Hakusensha published the eighth volume on September 29.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga for English release in September 2024 and published the fifth volume on July 28. The sixth volume is planned for a December 22 release.

PV 2

title: 'At 25:00, in Akasaka' Boys-Love Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
Pony Canyon announced on Wednesday the television anime adaptation of Hiroko Natsuno 's At 25:00, in Akasaka ( 25-Ji, Akasaka de ) boys-love manga, and presented the anime's teaser trailer, teaser visual, and main cast members. The anime will premiere in 2027 on the TBS channel.

The anime will star Sōma Saitō as Yuki Shirasaki (bottom in above visual), and Takuya Satō as Asami Hayama.

Pony Canyon describes the story:

Yuki Shirasaki (26), a newcomer actor, is set to star in a romantic drama about a relationship between two men alongside Asami Hayama (28), a hugely popular actor who was also his upperclassman at university. Struggling to convincingly portray a gay character, Shirasaki visits a gay bar in search of someone who can help him understand the role. However, for some reason, he ends up getting caught up with Hayama, and the two enter into a relationship as lovers... all for the sake of their acting. Their secret relationship, all for the sake of their roles, begins as filming gets underway!

Natsuno launched the manga in Shodensha 's on BLUE boys love magazine in November 2017, and ended it in October 2018. Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga in English. Natsuno launched a side story serialization for the manga in December 2018, and has been irregularly publishing the manga ever since. Shodensha published the manga's sixth and final compiled book volume on April 24. Seven Seas will publish the final volume on April 13, 2027. Publisher futekiya previously released the manga digitally in English, as well as Natsuno's The Love of Calendula ( Fuyu Shirazu no Koi ) manga.

The manga inspired a live-action series that debuted in 2024. It streamed in Japanese with English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Bahasa Indonesia, Spanish, and Thai worldwide on GagaOOLala, where it was the top-ranked series during its run. The second live-action season debuted in October 2025.

title: 'Now That We Draw' Anime's New Video Unveils More Cast, Ending Song Artist, January 8 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of Kyū Takahata and Yūji Kaba 's Now That We Draw ( Kakunaru Ue wa ) manga unveiled on Wednesday the anime's main promotional video, main visual, new cast member, and January 8 premiere. The anime's staff also announced the ending theme song "Serifu wa Iranai" (We Don't Need Dialogues) by the rock band Inner Journey . The video previews the opening theme song "Kimiiro Hikari" (The Light of Your Color) by the band shallm .

Hina Yomiya joins the cast as Ren Shioiri, a talented manga artist with a weekly series:

The anime will premiere on the Tokyo MX and BS11 channels on January 8 at 24:30 JST (effectively January 9 at 12:30 a.m.). The anime will run on AT-X on January 11 at 10:00 p.m. JST.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Dweeby high schooler Yūki Uehara has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she's bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara's dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Niina Miyamoto—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them have any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara's concocted, and he certainly isn't the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters?

Ayumu Murase and Sayumi Suzushiro will star as Yūki Uehara and Niina Miyamoto, respectively.

Shunsuke Ishikawa ( BLUE LOCK THE MOVIE -EPISODE NAGI- ) is directing the anime at ROLL2 , and Deko Akao ( Arakawa Under the Bridge , Komi Can't Communicate ) is supervising and writing the series scripts. Hiromi Nakagawa ( WATATEN!: an Angel Flew Down to Me , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is designing the characters, and Infinite is producing.

The additional staff includes:

• Sub-Character Design: Momoka Izumi

• Color Key Artist: Yurie Matsuura

• Art Director: Arei Saiga

• Compositing Director of Photography: Hayato Kifune (EOTA)

• 3D CG: Masashi Watanabe

• Editing: Mai Hasegawa

• Sound Director: Fumiyuki Go

• Sound Effects: Ryūta Nakahara

• Music: Yoshiaki Miura

• Produce: Infinite

The manga launched in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine in 2023, and Hakusensha published the eighth compiled book volume on September 29. Seven Seas Entertainment will publish the sixth volume in English on December 29.

title: Manga '25-ji, Akasaka de' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
An official website opened for a television anime adaptation of Hiroko Natsuno 's 25-ji, Akasaka de ( At 25:00 in Akasaka ) web manga on Wednesday, revealing the main cast, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video. The anime will premiere on TBS in 2027.

Voice actors Souma Saitou ( Odayaka Kizoku no Kyuuka no Susume. ) and Takuya Satou ( Super no Ura de Yani Suu Futari ) are starring in the anime as Yuki Shirasaki and Asami Hayama, respectively.

Natsuno began serializing the boys' love manga in onBLUE in November 2017. The series moved to the main onBLUE magazine in April 2018, where it remains ongoing. Shodensha published the fifth volume in June 2024. 25-ji, Akasaka de has surpassed 2 million copies in cumulative circulation, including digital editions.

The manga was digitally published in English as At 25:00, in Akasaka by Fantasista Inc. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the series for English print publication in March 2024, releasing the fifth volume in November 2025.

An audio drama adaptation produced by Fifth Avenue was released on CD. The first CD, adapting the first volume, went on sale in December 2020. The fifth and latest CD, adapting the fifth volume, was released in April 2025.

A live-action television drama adaptation produced by TV Tokyo and GagaOOLala aired for 10 episodes from April to June 2024. A second season aired from October to December 2025.

25-ji, Akasaka de won the Best Series category at the 2023 Chil Chil BL Awards . Its second audio drama CD also won the Best BLCD category at the same awards.

Synopsis Yuki Shirasaki finally landed his big break. But the pressure is on when he’s cast alongside current superstar (and his former classmate!) Asami Hayama. Determined to do his best, he decides to dive deep into researching playing the role of a gay man and visits a gay bar for a one-night stand. To his surprise, Hayama is there and gives Shirasaki the shock of his life by suggesting they become friends with benefits! Can Shirasaki keep his attention on the role, or will he be captivated by Hayama’s good looks and irresistible charm? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Migratory Birds & Snail TV Anime Debuts Next Summer
content:
The wraparound jacket band on Makoto Takatsu 's seventh compiled Wataridori to Katatsumuri ( Migratory birds & Snail ) manga volume announced that the television anime of the manga will premiere in summer 2027. The manga's latest volume shipped on Wednesday.

The manga tells the story of Unpei Mochizuki, a young man in his second year working at a machine parts distributor. After causing trouble to a customer because of a mistake he made, Unpei suddenly thought about going somewhere far away, where no on knows him. He stops his car on the side of the road, where he meets Tsugumi Nagisa, a picture book writer who travels in her car with her dog. Together, they start a free-spirited journey, going around Japan, traveling and sleeping in the car.

The manga's anime adaptation was first announced in 2024.

Takatsu launched the manga on Wani Books ' web manga magazine NewsCrunch in October 2019. Wani Books published the manga's first volume in August 2020, and the third volume in September 2021. The manga went on hiatus since the release of the third volume, and resumed serialization in 2024.

title: 'Youchien Wars' Unveils Staff, Main Promo, Opening Theme

title: Kindergarten Wars Anime's Video Reveals More Staff, ado's Opening Song, April Debut
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks unveiled the first full promotional video and main visual for the television anime of Yū Chiba 's Kindergarten WARS ( Yōchien Wars ) manga on Wednesday. The video announces more staff members and the April premiere for the anime, and also announces and previews the anime's opening theme song "Bibayatarametta" by singer Ado .

As previously announced, Shinsuke Gomi (episode director for Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba , Secrets of the Silent Witch ) is directing the anime at Sunrise and Felix Film , and Junko Yamanaka ( Kamisama Kiss , Servamp ) is designing the characters.

Takaomi Kanasaki ( KONOSUBA director, Princess Connect! Re:Dive director and writer, Secrets of the Silent Witch chief director and writer) joins the staff, and is writing and supervising the series' scripts. Satoru Kuwabara is the art director, while Saori Yoshiida is credited for color setting. Masaomi Suzuki is the CG director. Naoki Etō is the compositing director of photography, while Kashiko Kimura is the editor. Ryoshi Tanaka is the sound director. Hiroshi Nakamura , Kenta Higashiohji , and Dai Haraguchi are composing the music.

Yen Press is publishing the manga in print and it describes the story:

Rita is Convict 999, a former legendary assassin who now works at a kindergarten for the children of world leaders. Her job is to protect the schoolchildren from the clutches of would-be assassins sent after them! But even with her overwhelming strength, Rita has a weakness—she's head-over-heels for good-looking men!

The anime stars:

• Atsumi Tanezaki as Rita

• Kentarō Kumagai as Doug

• Hitomi Ohwada as Hana

• Satoshi Hino as Luke

• Mariya Ise as Silvia

• Romi Park as Erina

• Tetsu Inada as Gordon

• Mirei Kumagai as Mac

• Sumire Morohoshi as Una

Shueisha 's MANGA Plus website publishes the Kindergarten WARS manga digitally.

Chiba launched the manga on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ app and website in September 2022. Shueisha published the manga's 18th compiled book volume on August 4. The manga entered its final arc in March 2025, and has over 2 million copies in circulation.

Chiba launched the Yōchien Wars -LUKE- ( Kindergarten WARS -LUKE- ) spinoff manga in November 2024. The spinoff manga is a 180-page story about the character Luke.

title: 'Himekishi-sama no Himo' Reveals Supporting Cast, Second Promo
content:
The official website for the Himekishi-sama no Himo ( The Kept Man of the Princess Knight ) television anime adaptation revealed supporting cast and second promotional video on Wednesday. The anime adapting Tooru Shirogane 's action fantasy light novel will premiere on AT-X on January 3 at 11.30 p.m., followed by broadcasts on Tokyo MX and BS Asahi.

Cast Ralph: Yuuya Hirose ( World Is Dancing ) Noelle: Manaka Iwami ( Oni no Hanayome ) Beatrice Maretto: Shion Wakayama ( Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria ) Cecilia Maretto: Saori Oonishi ( Yomi no Tsugai )

Japanese rock group sajou no hana ( Himekishi wa Barbaroi no Yome ) is performing the ending theme "Gika," which is previewed in the promotional video below.

Chihiro Kumano ( Unnamed Memory assistant director) is helming the anime at Blade , with Deko Akao ( Ragna Crimson ) handling the series composition. Hisao Ishii ( Ushinawareta Mirai wo Motomete design assistant) is designing the characters. Taku Iwasaki is composing the music.

Shirogane began penning the action fantasy story under the Dengeki Bunko imprint in February 2022, with illustrations by Saki Mashima . Kadokawa published the seventh volume on July 10.

A manga adaptation drawn by Key Yang began in September 2022. The third and final volume was released in December 2024.

Chihiro Yamazaki launched a sequel of the manga titled Himekishi-sama no Himo Act 2 on the same website in August 2025. Kadokawa released the first volume on January 27.

Yen Press licensed both the light novel and manga adaptation in 2023. The sixth light novel volume was released on August 11. The third manga volume went on sale on January 6.
